title: dryopteris lacera
intro: Dryopteris lacera, commonly known as scaly male fern, is a species of fern in the family Dryopteridaceae. This plant has been traditionally used to treat various health issues, including inflammation and digestive problems, due to its health benefits. The therapeutic actions of Dryopteris lacera include anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antimicrobial properties, which contribute to its medicinal uses. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which are responsible for its therapeutic effects.
